extracted.intended_audience: University of Pennsylvania faculty, staff, postdocs, and graduate students seeking internal Provost-funded awards
extracted.subtask_description: A curated list of internal funding programs administered or highlighted by the Penn Provost’s Office, describing program purposes, target recipients, and high-level eligibility/priority goals. Useful for Penn researchers, faculty hires, postdocs, and graduate students seeking campus funding or support.

rubrics_metrics.name: University Research Foundation
rubrics_metrics.description: Offers limited support on a competitive basis for investigator research projects and scholarly conferences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Competitive, limited support for investigator-initiated research projects and for scholarly conferences. (Page provides a link for more information on specific eligibility, application, and award details.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Provost’s Interdisciplinary Arts Fund
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports art and culture initiatives at Penn that directly engage students and bring together multiple groups across campus, especially collaborations between art & culture organizations and academic departments or centers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to fund interdisciplinary arts and culture initiatives with direct student engagement and cross-campus collaboration; priority for projects that bridge arts organizations and academic departments/centers. (Follow link for application details and any limits.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Global Research and Engagement Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Penn Global administers a competitive global engagement grant program that provides resources to help faculty and staff undertake a range of research, teaching, service, and other activities with a country, region, or global focus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Competitive grants for global-focused activities across research, teaching, and service. Administered by Penn Global; further details (scope, eligibility, deadlines) available on the linked program page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dual Career
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides University funding when a standing faculty member is accompanied by a working spouse/partner, including a same-sex domestic partner, seeking employment at Penn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resource for hiring/retention when a recruited or standing faculty member's spouse/partner seeks employment; includes same-sex domestic partners. Likely subject to institutional policies and dean-level approval; see program page for procedures and limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty Opportunity Fund
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhances the academic strength and diversity of Penn faculty – reserved for candidates who, in the dean’s opinion, will make extraordinary scholarly contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted at exceptional faculty hires who will materially strengthen academic programs and diversity. Awards are discretionary and depend on dean-level evaluation of candidate's potential for extraordinary scholarly contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence Through Diversity Fund
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broadly scoped to support initiatives, research, and projects that advance diversity, equity, and inclusion across schools and campus. Use cases include strategic plan implementation, scholarship on diversity in higher ed, campus projects, and faculty-led work aligned with Penn Compact access goals. Application details and prioritization criteria available via the program link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Predoctoral Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: These awards are designed to provide mentorship and access to Penn’s resources for doctoral students in the humanities and social sciences, enrolled in graduate or professional programs at universities other than Penn, as they complete their dissertations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aimed at advanced doctoral students from other institutions working in humanities and social sciences who need mentorship and access to Penn resources to finish dissertations. Likely limited-term residential or resource-access awards; see linked page for eligibility, application process, and award terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoctoral Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: The Provost’s Postdoctoral Fellowships and CHOP’s Postdoctoral Fellowships are competitive programs intended to increase the diversity of the academic research community at the University of Pennsylvania and The Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Competitive postdoctoral fellowship programs with an explicit diversity-increasing mission for Penn and CHOP. Intended to support early-career scholars; applicants should consult the program pages for eligibility criteria, application requirements, and award structure.
